dialect.detail: JMA ORCA medical receipt system (Nihon Ishi-kai standard receipt software), compiled with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux. Uses COPY with REPLACING, INDEXED files, and Japanese EUC/latin-1 encoded comments.
evidence: ORGANIZATION IS INDEXED ACCESS MODE IS DYNAMIC

purpose.domain_detail: Japanese medical insurance receipt (レセプト) processing system — inpatient (入院) diagnosis/treatment point aggregation and receipt record generation for national health insurance billing
purpose.summary: ORCR0640 is a large batch program in the JMA ORCA medical receipt system that aggregates diagnosis/treatment classification points for inpatient receipts. It reads and writes multiple indexed ISAM files (RECE62, RECE64, RECE65, RECE69) representing receipt detail records, computes co-payment amounts, special fees, and various insurance-specific adjustments, and produces structured receipt output records for health insurance claim submission.

notable_features: 526 PERFORM statements indicating complex procedural logic
INDEXED file organization with DYNAMIC access on multiple files
COPY ... REPLACING syntax for record renaming
No EXEC SQL or EXEC CICS — pure file-based batch
Long revision history spanning 2002–2006 with named developers
verdict.notes: File decoded as latin-1 but comments are actually Japanese EUC-JP (double-byte characters appear garbled in latin-1). This is consistent with GnuCOBOL/OpenCOBOL on Linux used by the JMA ORCA project. No COMP-3 usage detected despite financial calculations — likely uses DISPLAY or COMP numeric fields. Source truncated to first 16000 chars; full file is ~492KB / 10307 lines.
